description: Use to convert money amounts for quotes, invoices, expense reports or price comparisons: converts an amount from one currency to another at the ECB reference rate of the latest working day or of a given past date (rates since 1999-01-04; weekends/holidays fall back to the previous working day). Returns the converted amount, the rate used and the rate date. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
name: fx_convert
title: ScrapeMole Pulse: FX rates (ECB), currency conversion, time zones, weather (global + official US NWS forecasts and alerts), Hacker News, public holidays and geocoding for AI agents: Currency conversion
